title: Sexual communal motivation in couples coping with low sexual interest/arousal
author: Jacqueline Hogue
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.zn3f5gn

steps.title: Prepare Dataset and Initial Filters
steps.instruction: Download and open the OSF_sexmot_SIAD.sav datafile using UTF-8 encoding.

steps.title: Analyze Demographic Data by Role
steps.instruction: Perform descriptive and frequency analyses on demographic variables, filtering by Role_A (1 or 2).

substeps.instruction: Filter for Role_A=2 and run frequencies for GENDER_A.
Filter for Role_A=1 and run frequencies for GENDER_A.
Run descriptives (MEAN, STDDEV, RANGE, MIN, MAX) for AGE_A for Role_A=1 and Role_A=2 separately.
Run descriptives for RelLENGTH_A (filter off).
Filter for Role_A=1 and run frequencies for REL_STAT_A.
Run frequencies for SEX_OR_A for Role_A=1 and Role_A=2 separately.
Run frequencies for ETHNIC_A, ETHNIC_P, and INCOME_A (MINIMUM, MAXIMUM).
Run descriptives for PROB_LENGTH_1_TEXT_A (MEAN, STDDEV, MIN, MAX).

steps.title: Analyze Psychological and Sexual Variables
steps.instruction: Calculate descriptives and correlations for key study variables, applying role filters where specified.

substeps.instruction: Filter for Role_A=1 and run descriptives (MEAN, STDDEV, MIN, MAX) for SCS_A, SCS_P, USC_A, USC_P, ApproachSexGoals_A, ApproachSexGoals_P, AvoidanceSexGoals_A, AvoidanceSexGoals_P, and DyadicSD_new.
Filter for Role_A=2 and run descriptives for DyadicSD_new.
Filter for Role_A=1 and run descriptives for GMSEXTotal_A, GMSEX_Total_P, SexDistress_A, and SexDistress_P.
Run frequencies for SEXFSexVag_A (MEAN, STDDEV, MIN, MAX).

Run pairwise correlations (TWOTAIL, NOSIG) for SCS_A, SCS_P, USC_A, USC_P, ApproachSexGoals_A, ApproachSexGoals_P, AvoidanceSexGoals_A, AvoidanceSexGoals_P, DyadicSD_new_A, DyadicSD_new_P, GMSEXTotal_A, GMSEX_Total_P, SexDistress_A, and SexDistress_P for both Role_A=2 and Role_A=1.

steps.title: Run Primary Mixed-Effects Models
steps.instruction: Execute mixed-effects models for primary outcomes using Role_A as the fixed factor and Couple as the subject (COVTYPE CSH).

substeps.instruction: Run models for DyadicSD_new, GMSEXTotal_A, SexDistress_A, ApproachSexGoals_A, and AvoidanceSexGoals_A using covariates SCS_A_c, SCS_P_c, USC_a_c, and USC_P_c.

steps.title: Run Control-Variable Mixed Models
steps.instruction: Repeat the mixed-effects models while controlling for relationship length and age.

substeps.instruction: Run models for the five primary outcomes controlling for RelLENGTH_A.
Run models for the five primary outcomes controlling for AGE_A and AGE_P.

steps.title: Run Specialized Mixed Models
steps.instruction: Perform additional mixed-effects analyses focusing on sexual function and goal approach.

substeps.instruction: Run models for ApproachSexGoals_A and SEXFSexVag_A using the standard covariates.
Run models for ApproachSexGoals_A adding SEXFSexVag_A_c and SEXFSexVag_P_c as covariates.
Run models for ApproachSexGoals_A using SEXFSexVag_ALOW and SEXFSexVag_AHIGH as covariates, including three-way interactions with Role_A and the standard covariates.
Run models for GMSEXTotal_A using SEXFSexVag_A_c/P_c, SEXFSexVag_ALOW, and SEXFSexVag_AHIGH, including relevant interactions.

steps.title: Analyze Mixed Cis-Gender Couples Subset
steps.instruction: Switch to the OnlyHeteroCouples.sav datafile and repeat the primary mixed-effects models.

substeps.instruction: Run mixed models for DyadicSD_new, GMSEXTotal_A, SexDistress_A, ApproachSexGoals_A, and AvoidanceSexGoals_A using covariates SCS_A_c, SCS_P_c, USC_a_c, and USC_P_c.
